name: Blue tail
description: White aircraft with 'skyalps' in big slanted lower case across the forward windows, 'sky' in light blue and 'alps' in dark blue. Blue fin and tail, the blue starting on the fuselage behind the aft door on a line slanting up from the belly; SkyAlps' white ring-and-mountain mark in the fin's middle. 'skyalps.com' on the nacelles.

areas.name: blue tail from behind the aft door
the long dorsal fairing ahead of the fin's leading edge stays white

titles.style: Big heavy slanted lower case across the windows from behind the forward door to the propeller, 'sky' in the lighter shade and 'alps' in the darker.
The name again with '.com', smaller, along the nacelle's side above the wing.

logos.description: SkyAlps' mark: a white open ring (a gap at its top) round a stylised mountain ridge drawn as an M, in the middle of the fin.

notes: Measured on 9H-MATI (Dash 8-400, left side, Gatwick, 2024-08-28) fitted to the Dash 8-400 shape; the blue aircraft were checked against it (9H-EVA 2023, 9H-PET and 9H-ALE 2024) and carry the same layout. The title runs x 0.19-0.44, baseline under the windows (y -0.25), ascenders to y 0.66 (about 2.5 m), lower case 0.63 of that, slanted. The tail's colour starts on the fuselage on a slanted line from the belly at x 0.825 to the crown at x 0.88, behind the aft door, and covers the tail cone. 'skyalps.com' on the nacelle is placed against the nacelle's ends in the photo (the nearer nacelle is out of the fuselage's plane), low confidence. SkyAlps flies its Dash 8s on its own Maltese certificate under ICAO SWU (9H-MATI flew as SWU1919 when the maintainer saw it); its fins are blue (standard) or a green forest (green), aircraft by aircraft. This blue scheme was measured on the green aircraft (the same layout) and checked on 9H-EVA's and 9H-PET's photos; its colours from 9H-EVA (overcast) and 9H-PET. The long dorsal fairing ahead of the fin's leading edge is white (a white fin area left of its leading edge: the Dash 8 shape draws the dorsal in the fin's base colour otherwise).
